content.title: About
content.content: The NFS powder sugar substitute is a blend of low‑calorie sweeteners designed to replace regular sugar in foods and beverages. It contains no glucose or fructose and does not raise the glycemic index, making it suitable for people monitoring blood sugar levels.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS is often based on stevia, erythritol or monk fruit extracts.
The powder form dissolves quickly and evenly in liquids.
The product is gluten‑free and fits a gluten‑free diet.
Unlike many artificial sweeteners, NFS is marketed as a natural option with a pleasant aftertaste.
It can be used in baking while maintaining the structure of the dough.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Contains 0–5 kcal per 100 g, helping to reduce overall caloric intake.

items.title: Does not raise blood glucose
items.content: Glycemic index is close to zero, making it safe for people with diabetes.

items.title: No artificial additives
items.content: Typically free of synthetic flavors and preservatives.

items.title: Supports weight management
items.content: Replacing sugar with NFS can lower sugar consumption without sacrificing sweetness.

items.title: Protects dental health
items.content: Unlike regular sugar, it does not promote tooth decay.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Some individuals may react to specific ingredients such as stevia or erythritol.

items.title: Digestive issues
items.content: Large amounts of erythritol can cause gas and diarrhea.

items.title: Not recommended for children under 3
items.content: Due to possible digestive upset, intake should be limited for young children.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Consult a healthcare professional if you are taking medications that affect blood sugar.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The powder can be added to tea, coffee, smoothies, yogurt, baking batters, sauces and marinades. Use a 1:1 volume ratio to replace sugar, but you may need to increase the amount slightly in baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For long‑term storage, keep it in the refrigerator to prevent clumping.
